segments.name: Products
segments.description: Sells and transfers goods to customers, using the company's Botanical Synthesis Platform Technology to produce plant-based ingredients and products.
segments.evidence: In the products business unit, the Company derives its revenue from selling and transferring goods.

segments.name: CDMO Services
segments.description: Provides end-to-end contract research, development and manufacturing services to customers for specific plant-based active molecules.
segments.evidence: In the CDMO Services business unit, the Company derives its revenue through completing an end-to-end service activity for the research, development and manufacturing of specific plant-based active molecules.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for goods sold and transferred, and for completed end-to-end research, development and manufacturing service work.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates revenue from two primary sources: (1) In the products business unit, the Company derives its revenue from selling and transferring goods.

changes.text: From 2024 the company reports the Products business unit and the CDMO Services business unit as its operating segments.
changes.evidence: Effective January 1, 2024, the Company has two operating segments or business units: the Products business unit and the CDMO Services business unit.
